newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean chip stocks rise on Merrill Lynch news.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean chip stocks rise on Merrill Lynch news.

text.p: South Korean semiconductor shares rose in Tuesday's late afternoon trading on news that Merrill Lynch had recommended two U.S. memory chip stocks on good PC demand, brokers said.

Samsung Electronics Co rose 3,200 won (or 5.95 percent) to 57,000, Hyundai Electronics climbed 2,500 won (7.91 percent) to its upper limit of 34,100 and LG Semicon gained 1,500 won (6.3 percent) to 25,300.
Merrill Lynch analyst Thomas Kurlak recommended Micron Technology and Texas Instruments, a Merrill Lynch source said in New York on Tuesday.
The analyst said in a note to clients that unit demand for PCs remains strong. Memory chips are a big component of PCs.
